commands.name: context-guard
commands.description: Show or set when the context-size prompt appears (percent of the window, or k tokens).
commands.argumentHint: [<threshold> <step> | off | on | reset | ask | style <dialog|band|both> | stats | stats share | stats reset]
commands.output:
context-guard is on: asks at 35% of the window (70k of 200k tokens), then every 10% (20k) after "Continue". Shows: the dialog and the band above the prompt. These are the defaults, not confirmed yet: it will ask on the next answer.
Usage: /context-guard <threshold> <step> | off | on | reset | ask | style <dialog|band|both> | stats | stats share | stats reset. Write each value as a percent of the window ("35%") or as thousands of tokens ("350k" or "350"), for example /context-guard 35% 10%.

children: context-guard is not set up: choose when it should ask
